Case note: CC/390/2021
Client: Uma Ahuja (railway employee, Thiruvananthapuram)
Opposing party: Deepak Bhosale
Court: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thiruvananthapuram
Filed on: 21 November 2021
Claim amount: 34.4 lakh rupees
Issue: cheque bounce. The cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match.
Advice given: Obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law.
Outcome: The magistrate accepted that a signature mismatch is a dishonour.
Recommended next step: Lead evidence through the bank official.
Witness: Vivek Agarwal
